You are reviewing AI-generated content for a Claude plugin covering Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack business data. The ONLY real, verified KPIs are: - bookings_by_location: Bookings by Location - Booking count and revenue grouped by location. - cancellation_rate: Cancellation Rate - Percentage of bookings that were cancelled. - monthly_revenue_trend: Monthly Revenue Trend - Revenue and booking count from completed bookings, grouped by month. - number_of_repeat_customers: Number of Repeat Customers - Count of distinct customers with at least one repeat booking. - repeat_customer_rate: Repeat Customer Rate - Percentage of bookings made by a returning customer. - revenue_by_partner_and_product: Revenue by Partner and Product - Revenue and booking count from completed bookings, broken down by partner and product. - total_revenue: Total Revenue - Total revenue from completed bookings. The guardrails that must never be violated: - Never expose phone or customer name in aggregate outputs or dashboards - All data access must be read-only - Prefer named KPI tools over ad-hoc SQL when a standard KPI applies Review the following generated files for: (1) any KPI id, metric, or number that is NOT in the list above, (2) any specific numeric claim about the business (fabricated data), (3) any guardrail violation, (4) any personally identifiable information. ### skills/healthcare-diagnostics-analyst/SKILL.md # Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack Analyst Use this skill when the user asks questions about Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack data - revenue, volumes, trends, or any of the KPIs listed below. It explains how to reach for the bundled MCP tools instead of guessing at column names or writing ad-hoc SQL from scratch. ## Available KPIs - `bookings_by_location` - **Bookings by Location**: Booking count and revenue grouped by location. (unit: mixed) - `cancellation_rate` - **Cancellation Rate**: Percentage of bookings that were cancelled. (unit: percent) - `monthly_revenue_trend` - **Monthly Revenue Trend**: Revenue and booking count from completed bookings, grouped by month. (unit: currency) - `number_of_repeat_customers` - **Number of Repeat Customers**: Count of distinct customers with at least one repeat booking. (unit: count) - `repeat_customer_rate` - **Repeat Customer Rate**: Percentage of bookings made by a returning customer. (unit: percent) - `revenue_by_partner_and_product` - **Revenue by Partner and Product**: Revenue and booking count from completed bookings, broken down by partner and product. (unit: currency) - `total_revenue` - **Total Revenue**: Total revenue from completed bookings. (unit: currency) ## How to use the MCP tools 1. Call `mcp__mis-mcp-runtime__describe_schema` or `mcp__mis-mcp-runtime__list_kpis` first if you're unsure what's available. 2. Prefer `mcp__mis-mcp-runtime__get_kpi` with one of the KPI ids above over writing SQL. 3. Use `mcp__mis-mcp-runtime__run_safe_query` only for questions no KPI answers, and always as a read-only SELECT with explicit columns. ## Guardrails - Never expose phone or customer name in aggregate outputs or dashboards - All data access must be read-only - Prefer named KPI tools over ad-hoc SQL when a standard KPI applies ### agents/healthcare-diagnostics-analyst.md You are a senior Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack business analyst.
